member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.Filter.Operator
member.summary: Gets or sets an operator used when comparing the to the .
member.value: A value indicating the operator used when comparing the to the .

remarks.para: Top and Bottom operators include ties in the resulting data.
String comparisons are locale-dependent.
Null equals Null.

member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.Filter.FilterValues
member.summary: Gets the values to compare to the .
member.value: An object containing the values to compare to the .

remarks.para: For Equal, Like, NotEqual, GreaterThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThan, LessThanOrEqual, TopN, BottomN, TopPercent and BottomPercent, there must be exactly one .
For TopN and BottomN, the expression must evaluate to an integer.
For TopPercent and BottomPercent, the expression must evaluate to an integer or a float.

For TopN, BottomN, TopPercent and BottomPercent, the FilterValue expression is evaluated only once: for the first row (after all earlier filters have been applied) in the case of a dataset or data region; a filter for the first group instance (after all earlier filters have been applied) in the case of a group filter.
For Between, there must be exactly two .
For In, the are treated as a set (if the FilterExpression value appears anywhere in the set of , the instance is not filtered out).
Like uses the same special characters as the Visual Basic LIKE operator (e.g. "?" to represent a single character and "*" to represent any series of characters).

member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating how the image is rendered if it does not fit within the defined size.
member.value: An value indicating how the image is rendered if it does not fit within the defined size.

remarks.para: If is set to , the control's borders grow or shrink to match the size of the image.
If is set to , the image is resized to match the height and width of the control.
If is set to , the image is resized while preserving the aspect ratio to match either the height or width of the control or both.
If is set to , the image is clipped to fit inside the borders of the control.

summary.para: Gets or sets a drillthrough report that is executed by clicking the hyperlink.

summary.para: Gets or sets an expression that evaluates to the ID of a bookmark within the report to which to navigate when the report item is clicked.

value.para: An ExpressionInfo object that evaluates to the ID of a bookmark within the report to which to navigate when the report item is clicked.

remarks.para: If no bookmark with this ID is found, the link is not included in the report. If the bookmark is hidden, the link goes to the start of the page of the bookmark. If multiple bookmarks with the ID are found, the link goes to the first one.

member.name: T:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.Subtotal
member.summary: Represents a Subtotals element defines a subtotal column or row to include in a matrix.

remarks.para: In the subtotal column or row, the full set of data for the entire group is aggregated in the matrix cell.

If a matrix cell contains an aggregate that uses an explicit grouping scope contained within the scope of the aggregate, that scope is automatically adjusted to equal the current scope. For example, if a textbox in a matrix cell contains the expression =Sum(Fields!Sales.Value/Sum(Fields!Sales.Value,"State") and this subtotal is applied to the Country grouping scope, the expression evaluates to =Sum(Fields!Sales.Value)/Sum(Fields!Sales.Value,"Country"), since the State grouping scope is contained within the country grouping scope.

member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.Visibility.ToggleItem
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the used to toggle the visibility of the report item.
member.value: A value indicating the name of the textbox used to toggle the visibility of the report item.

remarks.para: Clicking an instance of the ToggleItem toggles the hidden state of every corresponding instance of the item. If the ToggleItem becomes hidden, this item becomes hidden. This cascading does not apply if the ToggleItem becomes hidden as a result of a containing table column or matrix cell becoming hidden.
The ToggleItem must be a textbox in the same grouping scope as this item or in any containing grouping scope.
If a value for the ToggleItem is omitted, no item toggles the hidden state of this item.
ToggleItems are not allowed on and cannot refer to report items contained in a page header or footer.
ToggleItems cannot refer to a report item contained within the current report item unless the current grouping scope has a parent.

example.code: visibility.ToggleItem = "ToggleTextBoxName";

member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.ReportItem.ZIndex
member.summary: Gets or sets a drawing order of the report item within its container.
member.value: An value indicating the drawing order of the report item within the containing object.

remarks.para: Items with lower indices are drawn first and appear behind items with higher indices.
Items with the same index have an unspecified order.
The default value is 0. The range is 0 to 2147483647.

example.code: var reportItem = new TextBox(); reportItem.ZIndex = 2;

member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the report item is hidden.

member.summary: Gets or sets a tooltip for the report item.
member.value: An object evaluating to the tooltip text.
member.remarks: The tooltip is used for elements such as TITLE and ALT attributes in HTML reports.

example.code: var reportItem = new TextBox(); reportItem.ToolTip = "This is a tooltip.";

member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.ReportItem.Label
member.summary: Gets or sets a label for identifying an instance of a report item within the client UI (e.g., a user-friendly label for searching or appearing in the Document Map).
member.value: An object representing the label text.

remarks.para: The label is used in hierarchical listings of report items within the UI (the Document Map) based on the object containment hierarchy in the report definition. Peer items are listed in left-to-right, top-to-bottom order.
If the expression returns null, no item is added to the Document Map.
Labels are not used for report items in the page header or footer.

example.code: var reportItem = new TextBox(); reportItem.Label = "Section 1";

member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.ReportItem.LinkToChild
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of a report item contained within this report item that serves as the target location for the Document Map label (if any).
member.value: A value indicating the name of the contained report item.

remarks.para: Used only for items.
This property is ignored if a is not present.

example.code: var containerItem = new Container(); containerItem.LinkToChild = "ChildItemName";

member.name: T:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.Style
member.summary: The Style element contains information about the style of a report item. Where possible, the style property names and values match standard HTML/CSS properties. All expression-based Style elements evaluate to either the type listed or to Nothing (an error in evaluation is treated as Nothing). Nothing is equivalent to not specifying the style, thereby indicating that it uses the default value. The epxression must evaluate to a Boolean value for Boolean properties, an enumerated value for enum properties, an integer for integer properties and a (formatted) string for all other properties.

member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.UserSort.SortExpression
member.summary: Gets or sets the expression used for sorting.
member.value: A object representing the expression used for sorting.
member.remarks: This property specifies the expression used to determine the sorting order. It should adhere to the same rules as grouping filter expressions. Aggregates within should only reference scopes that are equal to or contain . If is not specified, aggregates must define their scope.

example.code: UserSort userSort = new UserSort(); userSort.SortExpression = ExpressionInfo.FromString("Fields!Name.Value");

member.name: P:GrapeCity.ActiveReports.PageReportModel.UserSort.SortExpressionScope
member.summary: Gets or sets the scope within which is evaluated.
member.value: A value indicating the scope within which is evaluated.

remarks.para: If specified, defines the grouping or dataset scope where is evaluated.
The scope must be either identical to or contained within the current scope. If the has no scope is undefined, must be within .

Sorting occurs within the group containing . For example, in a report with state and city groups where each header has and corresponding groups have , state sorting sorts state groups within the report, and city sorting sorts city groups within each state group without rearranging country state groups.

member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the data region, grouping, or dataset to which the sort is applied.
